geographicReview.notes: Exact mapped pitch axis and actual stadium body align with the north-up outline; main facade screen is west. The incorrect wide estate footprint was retained as rejected evidence. Six mapped elevated approach ramps join the terrace; nativeY0 is outer ground/pitch contact.
